subject: Linux binaries for arm64 / building from source?

messages.author: ca3205004f4bea24
messages.subject: Linux binaries for arm64 / building from source?
parts: I've got a couple of NVIDIA Jetson development kits and want to get r-inla running on them. They run Ubuntu 18.04 LTS on multi-core arm64 modules. Is there a Linux binary for this architecture? If not, where's the source code - I can probably build them from source.

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Linux binaries for arm64 / building from source?
parts:
I put at

hrue.r-inla-download.org/build64.tgz

the build directory I use for Ubuntu18.04 on x86.

I do

export INLA_TAG=Version_20.07.16-1
make update

and it will download that 'tag' from the git-repo, and compile the
binaries.

you have to use the TAG that is the same as your INLA version

> inla.version("version")
[1] "20.07.16-1"


and then I find the binaries at

local/bin/inla
local/bin/inla.mkl
local/bin/fmesher


you can set

library(INLA)
inla.setOption(inla.call='/home/.../bin/inla')
inla.setOption(fmesher.call='/home/.../bin/fmesher')

to use that binary


you need to recompile the libs for arm64, like

make -C gmrflib clean
make -C inlaprog clean
make taucs
make amd

etc

hope it works!
H
